name: 7 Days Customer Trend
query:
WITH RECURSIVE date_list AS (
    SELECT CURDATE() AS `date`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 DAY)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 DAY)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
),
invoice_production_times AS (
    SELECT
        pos_invoice.name AS invoice_id,
        AVG(TIMEDIFF(TIMESTAMP(
        CASE
            WHEN formatted_kot.start_time_serv > formatted_kot.start_time_prep THEN formatted_kot_date
            ELSE DATE_ADD(formatted_kot_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        END, formatted_kot.start_time_serv), TIMESTAMP(formatted_kot_date, formatted_kot.start_time_prep))) AS avg_production_time_seconds
    FROM date_list
    LEFT JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` pos_invoice ON (
        pos_invoice.branch = %(branch)s
        AND pos_invoice.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
        AND pos_invoice.`docstatus` = 1
    )
        LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
        rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    )
    JOIN
        (SELECT
            kot.*,
             DATE(kot.date) AS formatted_kot_date
         FROM
             `tabURY KOT` AS kot
        WHERE kot.order_status = 'Served'
        ) AS formatted_kot
    ON pos_invoice.name = formatted_kot.invoice
    WHERE
        (
            ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND pos_invoice.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
            OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(pos_invoice.`posting_date`, pos_invoice.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(pos_invoice.`posting_date`, pos_invoice.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
            OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND pos_invoice.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
        )
    GROUP BY
        pos_invoice.name
)
SELECT
    date_list.`date` AS "Date:Date:150",
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            TIME_TO_SEC(
                ADDTIME('00:00:00', total_spend_time)
            )
        )
    ) /60 AS `Spend Time:Float:100`,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_production_time_seconds))/60 AS `Production Time:Float:100`
FROM date_list
LEFT JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` pos_invoice ON (
    pos_invoice.branch = %(branch)s
    AND pos_invoice.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
    AND pos_invoice.`docstatus` = 1
)
LEFT JOIN invoice_production_times
ON pos_invoice.name = invoice_production_times.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
    rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
)
WHERE
    (
        ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND pos_invoice.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
        OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(pos_invoice.`posting_date`, pos_invoice.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(pos_invoice.`posting_date`, pos_invoice.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
        OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND pos_invoice.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
    )
GROUP BY 
    date_list.`date`
ORDER BY 
    date_list.`date` ASC
